title: Amplifier protection triggered
shortDescription: Pioneer AVR showed AMP ERR and shut down due to amp fault or speaker short.
fullDescription:
Pioneer VSX and Elite SC receivers display AMP ERR when the amp stage detects a fault. Most often triggered by speaker short or DC offset.

Elite SC class D models are notorious for amp board failures after 5-8 years.

causes.cause: Class D amp IC failure (Elite SC)

fixSteps.title: Service amp board
fixSteps.instruction: AMP ERR with no speakers means internal failure.

whenToCallPro: AMP ERR with no speakers connected.

faq.q: Is Elite SC class D reliable?
faq.a: Efficient but amp ICs have failure rate after 5+ years.

title: Thermal shutdown
shortDescription: Pioneer AVR shut down due to over-temperature.
fullDescription: Pioneer VSX receivers run hot. Tight cabinets or stacking other gear on top quickly causes thermal shutdown.

fixSteps.title: Clear top surface
fixSteps.instruction: No items on top of AVR.

title: HDMI handshake error
shortDescription: Black screen due to HDMI/HDCP negotiation failure.
fullDescription: Pioneer LX305/LX505 models share the Denon/Marantz HDMI 2.1 bug. Issues with 4K120 and VRR on Xbox/PS5. Addressed via firmware and adapter program.

fixSteps.title: Request HDMI adapter
fixSteps.instruction: Eligible owners can request HDMI 2.1 bug adapter.

faq.a: Yes for eligible models under 2020 program.

title: MCACC room calibration failed
fullDescription: Pioneer's MCACC (Multi-Channel Acoustic Calibration) fails on mic issues, speaker miswiring, or background noise. Similar to Audyssey/YPAO.

faq.a: Elite SC-LX models offer Dirac Live upgrade.

title: Video works but no audio
fullDescription: Usually mute, wrong audio routing, or eARC negotiation fault.

title: Firmware update failed
fullDescription: Network drop or power loss mid-update can brick temporarily. USB recovery available on most models.

title: Speaker wire fault
shortDescription: Amp self-test detected short or no load.
fullDescription: Pioneer amps do an impedance check on power-up. Stray strands trigger CHECK SP.

faq.a: Most models accept banana plugs - check local regulations.

title: Zone 2 silent
fullDescription: Pioneer Zone 2 supports analog or 2-channel PCM only. HDMI bitstream won't pass.

faq.a: Zone B = stereo duplicate of main zone.

title: Streaming features offline
fullDescription: Pioneer Remote app and streaming providers offline when network is disrupted. Similar to HEOS/MusicCast but uses different cloud.

faq.a: Yes on most newer Pioneer AVRs.

title: Subwoofer silent
fullDescription: MCACC may set speakers to Large. Set Small to redirect bass to sub.

faq.a: Select Elite models have dual independent sub outs.
